    d = ObjectDict()
    d.foo = 42
    assert d["foo"] == 42
    assert d.foo == 42

    assert d["bar"] == "qux"

def test_missing_attribute_raises_attributeerror():
    d = ObjectDict()
    d["existing"] = 1
    assert d.existing == 1
    with pytest.raises(AttributeError) as exc:
        _ = d.nonexistent
    assert str(exc.value) == "nonexistent"

def test_dict_methods_and_attribute_interaction():

    d.a = 1
    d.b = 2

    assert keys == {"a", "b"}

    assert items == {"a": 1, "b": 2}
    d.update({"c": 3})
    assert d.c == 3
    del d["a"]
